overview: Louisville City Council approved all consent agenda items and regular business on October 20, 2026, including economic development agreements totaling $489,514 for Arsenal Health LLC and Infleqtion Quantum LLC, a $100,000 wildfire mitigation agreement with Boulder Watershed Collective, and preservation grants for the Grain Elevator and Mudrock House. The council also held a public hearing on the 2027-2028 budget presentation with final adoption scheduled for a future meeting.
actions: Approved $208,400 Business Assistance Agreement with Arsenal Health LLC for economic development
Approved $281,114 Enhanced Business Assistance Agreement with Infleqtion Quantum, LLC for economic development
Allocated $100,000 to Boulder Watershed Collective for wildfire mitigation program
Established expedited review policies for affordable housing projects under Proposition 123 commitment
Filed affordable housing commitment with State of Colorado for Proposition 123 funds eligibility
Approved preservation and restoration grants for Grain Elevator (540 County Road) and Mudrock House (613 Grant Avenue)
Approved Xcel Energy rebates for city EV charging station infrastructure project
Held public hearing on 2027-2028 budget; final adoption scheduled for November 2, 2026 meeting
Discussed Board and Commission Handbook follow-up with staff feedback; item may return for future action
